prompt_en: An editorial photograph for a complex visual test concept features a reference-guided fictional adult performer, age 28, during a staged photographic performance in a contemporary black-box theater. The attached portrait guides visible eye, face, and bob-hair appearance only. Her large dark brown eyes, soft oval face, and chin-length dark bob with wispy fringe carry a quietly magnetic presence. She stands facing the camera on a low dry black platform, both shoes planted, holding the side seams of her wide-sleeved midnight-blue silk robe at hip height with gently bent elbows so its central chest panel lies flat. On the broad chest panel, a tortoise form belongs to the selected embroidered robe motif: one domed segmented shell, one distinct head, four legs, and a short tail. Within the same emblem, a separate snake winds around that same tortoise motif; its one head rises beyond the shell while its continuous slender coil crosses the near shell edge. Fine gold-and-silver stitches catch the grazing light, and the tortoise and snake remain embroidery on cloth rather than wearer anatomy. Directly behind her head, one warm-gold circular luminous disk forms a head nimbus. Behind the same performer, an almond-shaped enclosure has distinct upper and lower tips, with a cool-white cusp above her hair and another below both shoes. Its two luminous sides bow outward around the robe; the depicted full figure is contained inside the same enclosure. In this nested stage-light design, the full-body enclosure has a different spatial extent from a head halo, leaving the small head disk separately legible within the larger mandorla. Her hands draw the fabric just outward, leaving the emblem exposed. A soft sidelight warms her face and the sculptural robe folds. Two open charcoal scrim panels recede into the wings. A frontal full-figure view leaves an unbroken margin around both almond tips while a broad, unfolded chest area makes the silver serpent crossing the gold shell legible. Eyes lead, then the chest emblem, then the two nested light scopes. The intimate still moment belongs to a contemporary costume-and-light artwork.
